"use client"
// Probe for the upload-surface arm of tests/unit/all-clear-honesty.test.ts.
// GREEN: the "running in the background" copy renders only under the
// action's own `queued` verdict; the quota and consent branches say what
// actually happened.

import { commitScannedPolicy } from "@/app/(protected)/agent/actions"

type Outcome = "queued" | "blocked_quota" | "blocked_consent" | "none"

export function ProbeSuccessView({ up, result }: { up: any; result: { analysis: Outcome } }) {
    return (
        <div>
            {result.analysis === 'queued' && (
                <p role="status">{up.analysisStarted}</p>
            )}
            {result.analysis === "queued" ? <p>{"Η ανάλυση τρέχει στο παρασκήνιο"}</p> : null}
            {result.analysis === 'blocked_quota' && <p>{up.analysisBlockedQuota}</p>}
        </div>
    )
}

export async function probeCommit(fd: FormData) {
    return commitScannedPolicy({ mode: "attach", customerId: "c" }, {} as any, false, fd)
}
